summary: Structured-key grouping: events become cells keyed by location (0.25deg grid / ADM1 / country per ActionGeo_Type), unordered CAMEO actor pair and coop/conflict family. Solid cells are union-found: generic (no foreign actor) cells per point location or per country ('national domestic' story), international cells by the set of countries involved, and cells sharing a foreign actor at the same non-capital point. A co-burst pass merges bursty components with near-identical onset within 500 km. Score = independent voices (outlets with own text + one per syndicated text; iheart excluded) x (0.5 + 0.5 x share of voices arriving within 12h of onset).
